ceu: ✦ The trine between the Moon and the Sun at {H:1803566882000}

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.

The trine between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Take a long bath and imagine the water carrying away the weight of the day.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.

The trine between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: If you have an agreement to make, put everything in writing.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.

The trine between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Go to bed half an hour earlier than usual.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.

The trine between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Spend half an hour on a hobby just for the pleasure of it.

t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.

The trine between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Put a plant or fresh flowers in your home.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.

The trine between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Read a few pages of a book instead of spending the time on your phone.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.

The trine between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, money and routine: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Review this week's spending and cut one thing you do not need.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.

The trine between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.

The trine between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.

The trine between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.

The trine between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, your career and money: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.

The trine between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Look at a problem as if someone else were seeing it.
